Description

Health Test Status for 32-bit Entropy Stream (Write-1-to-Clear). Latches health test failures until firmware clears by writing 1. Bit allocation: [0]=Repetition, [1:2]=Reserved, [3]=APT, [4]=Markov-Hi, [5]=Markov-Lo, [6:7]=Reserved.
